NASA's Kennedy Space Center on Instagram: "Liftoff! NASA’s Artemis II rocket and spacecraft carrying astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT on Wednesday, April 1, 2026 from Launch Complex 39B from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The crew will journey on a 10-day mission around the Moon before splashdown in the Pacific Ocean.
Video credit: NASA/Elyna Niles-Carnes"
content.text: Liftoff! NASA’s Artemis II rocket and spacecraft carrying astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT on Wednesday, April 1, 2026 from Launch Complex 39B from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The crew will journey on a 10-day mission around the Moon before splashdown in the Pacific Ocean.Video credit: NASA/Elyna Niles-CarnesVery amazing this video 📷When I was 11 we went to see a shuttle launch. We got there kinda late and the whole place was mobbed for miles, so we ended up on a beach about 5 or 6 miles from the launch pad. When the shuttle went up, for several seconds it was perfectly silent. Then, in the distance, I could see the humid air shimmering. It rushed across the ground at me, I saw the wave pass me, I felt it hit me in the chest, and from then on I heard the deafening roar of the engines. It was an incredibly humbling and awe inspiring experience.That does not look like it went to spaceSearch. For.
